steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each invoice is placed by its matter and its budget.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Invoice with no matter
findings.fix: Assign the invoice to a matter before paying

findings.title: Matter fees above its budget
findings.fix: Agree a budget change with the matter owner

findings.title: Invoice duplicates another on amount and date

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] inv-2204.md:12  Invoice with no matter.
       Fix: Assign the invoice to a matter before paying.
[medium] inv-2202.md:19  Matter fees above its budget.

[low] inv-2206.md:26  Invoice duplicates another on amount and date.

Not checked: Whether the work was necessary.
pros: Checks an invoice with no matter, a matter with fees above its budget, and an invoice that duplicates another on amount and date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the work was necessary.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-counsel-spend skill on the records for this review.
